channel.title: Paksh: Politics
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Trump Criticizes Arizona Election Officials Over Ballot Error
item.description: Former U.S. President Donald Trump has criticized election officials in Arizona's Maricopa County regarding an error that affected approximately 3,000 ballots. The Toronto Star reported on this criticism. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
